name: System Member Role
definition: Information about the members of a system.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of the relationship a member has with a system.

CashBalance.name: Cash Balance
CashBalance.definition: Cash balance for which a counterparty is specified.

MemberStatus.name: Member Status
MemberStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a member.

Limit.name: Limit
Limit.definition: Cash management feature limiting the maximum risk a party accepts to take with respect to a counterparty or a set of counterparties. A risk management limit is either bilateral, ie, for a counterparty, or multilateral, ie, for a set of counterparties or all other members in a system.The limit may also apply to sponsored members, ie, indirect members. In principle, a risk management limit is calculated on the net position between two members and is expressed as a credit or debit limit, from the point of view of the party setting the limit.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account owned by the member of a system with the system.
